source.trajectories: The same 60 frozen AIME26 FP-token trajectories used by QWEN_HADAMARD_TRAJECTORY_STABILITY_ANALYSIS_V1
source.primary_panel: The prior preregistered clean59 panel; exclude only the frozen aime26_28 seed 2 pair
source.teacher_forcing: All conditions receive identical frozen token IDs; no sampling or free generation

geometry.observation_point: Recurrent state immediately after the existing per-token QDQ step in the frozen GDN runtime
geometry.basis: Native FP key basis. Identity state is already native; Hadamard state is pulled back with the same H128 inverse used by the frozen patch before subtraction
geometry.state_vector: Flatten all heads, key channels and value channels in one fixed GDN layer; no head or layer selection
geometry.cos_error_fp: dot(e,S_FP)/(L2(e)*L2(S_FP)), defined only when both norms exceed 1e-12
geometry.cos_error_identity_hadamard: dot(e_identity,e_hadamard)/(L2(e_identity)*L2(e_hadamard)), defined only when both norms exceed 1e-12
geometry.secondary_readout_alignment: At the existing GDN norm-input hook, cosine(r_INT8-r_FP,r_FP) in readout space. This is not a state-space cosine or a state-to-logits Jacobian.
geometry.undefined_cosine: Store null and an explicit validity count; do not impute, clamp denominators into a fabricated direction, or delete the row

aggregation_and_tests.primary_unit: One frozen trajectory (problem_id, seed). Take the median over all token x 24 fixed GDN-layer rows for each scalar; equal weight per trajectory thereafter.
aggregation_and_tests.paired_contrasts: Hadamard minus Identity for error_norm, relative_error, cos_error_fp and secondary readout alignment; lower magnitude is descriptive, cosine direction has no preassigned benefit sign
aggregation_and_tests.cross_error_cosine: Summarize one common Identity-Hadamard cosine per token/layer, then by trajectory and outcome group; lower cosine means different error directions, not necessarily less functional damage
aggregation_and_tests.groups: Reconstruct stable_correct, hadamard_rescue, stable_failure from frozen real IDs only after replay; retain identity_only_correct if any
aggregation_and_tests.uncertainty: Trajectory bootstrap of paired/group medians, 5000 resamples, fixed seed 20260925
aggregation_and_tests.group_test: Rescue versus stable_failure two-sided 10000-label-permutation contrast of medians for every preregistered scalar; report Cliff's delta and both group bootstrap intervals. Stable_correct remains a control.
aggregation_and_tests.multiple_testing: Apply Holm correction across the four rescue-versus-stable-failure tests; other readout-space diagnostics are secondary and not used for a primary claim.
aggregation_and_tests.no_selection: No outcome-dependent token, layer, head, threshold or outlier selection; no post hoc favorable metric or sign selection
aggregation_and_tests.interpretation: Phase 1 can establish whether the error geometry differs. It cannot establish J e, downstream functional harm, logits sensitivity, causality, or a learnable rotation objective.

gates.before_formal_replay: Source and hash audit, repeated 128-token geometry replay, prior state scalar parity, same token IDs, H128 orthogonality and native-basis check must pass
gates.numeric_validity: All state norms and relative errors finite; undefined cosine counts explicitly reported
gates.storage: Only scalar parquet rows and compact reports/figures; no complete state or logit tensors are serialized
